description: Implementation of various IOBuffer classes in the net namespace, including IOBuffer, IOBufferWithSize, StringIOBuffer, DrainableIOBuffer, GrowableIOBuffer, PickledIOBuffer, and WrappedIOBuffer, used for buffer management in network operations.

classes.name: IOBuffer
classes.description: Base class for buffer management, providing data pointer and basic constructors/destructors.

classes.name: IOBufferWithSize
classes.description: Extends IOBuffer to include size information.

classes.name: StringIOBuffer
classes.description: Buffer class that manages string data, allowing construction from std::string.

classes.name: DrainableIOBuffer
classes.description: Buffer that supports consuming bytes and tracking remaining data.

classes.name: GrowableIOBuffer
classes.description: Resizable buffer supporting dynamic capacity adjustments.

classes.name: PickledIOBuffer
classes.description: Buffer that manages pickled data, with a method to finalize data pointer.

classes.name: WrappedIOBuffer
classes.description: Buffer that wraps existing const data pointers.

methods.name: AssertValidBufferSize
methods.description: Checks if buffer size is valid, accepting size_t or int.

methods.name: SetCapacity
methods.description: Sets the capacity of GrowableIOBuffer, reallocating memory.

methods.name: set_offset
methods.description: Sets the current offset within GrowableIOBuffer.

methods.name: StartOfBuffer
methods.description: Returns pointer to start of buffer in GrowableIOBuffer.

methods.name: DidConsume
methods.description: Marks bytes as consumed in DrainableIOBuffer.

methods.name: BytesRemaining
methods.description: Returns number of bytes remaining in DrainableIOBuffer.

methods.name: BytesConsumed
methods.description: Returns number of bytes consumed in DrainableIOBuffer.

methods.name: Done
methods.description: Finalizes the data pointer in PickledIOBuffer.
